svg.aria-label: smaller things: henrys-come-to-see-us, A full auto M4A1 for a game set in 1403, with its own model, sounds and reloads, and a native plugin that drives it. qol-skills, Claude Code and Codex skills that teach coding agents how qol is built, tested and released. pointz, Flutter app for controlling your PC from your phone.
